user.title: Aprilaire 8800 (RS-485)
user.description:
Connect to one or more Aprilaire Model 8800 thermostats via a local serial port (typically through an Aprilaire 8811 Protocol Adapter) or a TCP-to-RS-485 gateway.

Examples for the Port field:
- /dev/ttyUSB0 (local serial)
- COM3 (Windows)
- socket://192.168.1.50:8000 (TCP gateway, raw)
- rfc2217://192.168.1.50:2217 (RFC 2217)

data.outdoor_temp_rebroadcast: Rebroadcast outdoor temperature from a sensor-equipped thermostat

data_description.port: Pyserial URL or local device path.
data_description.baud: Thermostat bus baud rate. For TCP gateways this is unrelated to the TCP link.
data_description.max_address: Set this to your actual node count (also set NETST on each thermostat to match).
data_description.addresses: Comma-separated list of node addresses (1-64). Leave blank to auto-discover.
data_description.outdoor_temp_source: A temperature sensor, or a weather/climate entity. Its value is pushed to thermostats that lack their own outdoor sensor.
data_description.outdoor_temp_rebroadcast: When no source is set, share the outdoor reading from the lowest-addressed thermostat that has its own sensor.

error.invalid_url: Not a recognised pyserial URL or device path.
error.invalid_addresses: Addresses must be a comma-separated list of integers between 1 and 64.

data.outdoor_temp_rebroadcast: Rebroadcast outdoor temperature from a sensor-equipped thermostat

data_description.outdoor_temp_source: A temperature sensor, or a weather/climate entity. Its value is pushed to thermostats that lack their own outdoor sensor. Clear it to fall back to rebroadcast.
data_description.outdoor_temp_rebroadcast: When no source is set, share the outdoor reading from the lowest-addressed thermostat that has its own sensor.

send_temporary_message.name: Send temporary message
send_temporary_message.description: Display a transient message on the thermostat LCD. The message stays visible until cleared or until the thermostat loses power. ASCII only; non-ASCII characters are stripped. Maximum 32 characters.

clear_temporary_message.name: Clear temporary message
clear_temporary_message.description: Remove any temporary message currently displayed on the thermostat LCD. Does not affect permanent message slots.

set_permanent_message.name: Set permanent message
set_permanent_message.description: Write text to one of the four permanent message slots. Permanent messages persist across power cycles. Which permanent slot is currently displayed is selected on the device itself.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to store in the slot.

clear_permanent_message.name: Clear permanent message
clear_permanent_message.description: Wipe one of the four permanent message slots.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Permanent message slot to clear (1 through 4).
